thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: marigold (VPC, dedicated pool) — elevated funcall parser errors observed. Alert flood for tenant marigold: ~15% error rate on tool/function-calls, increased tail latency. Paging oncall.
alice: acked. I'm on it. Any impact to other tenants?
marigold-ops: saw many 500s this morning, customers seeing failed invoice parsing flows. Impacting 4 tenants inside Marigold org. No cross-tenant errors reported.
alice: grabbing logs and traces now. Looking at dedicated pool 'ded-marigold-01'.
carla: I can help with kernel metrics / GPU routing if needed.
alice: initial log snippet from runtime:
```
[2025-09-12T14:02:31Z] ERROR funcall-parser tenant=marigold request_id=abc123 "unexpected token \"meta_v2\" at position 12"
[2025-09-12T14:02:32Z] WARN kv-cache miss tenant=marigold key=ctx_987
```
alice: seems like schema drift — customer started submitting a nested metadata object `meta_v2` in tool call args. Parser was strict for `meta` flat string. Parser now throws.
ben: is this only the new model variant or all variants? Could be a compiled parser in the serving runtime.
alice: error spike aligns with the deploy at 13:55 UTC. Looking at canary logs, only marigold impacted. Dedicated pool isolates this tenant, so other customers unaffected. Good.
carla: possible quick mitigation: enable permissive parser fallback in runtime for marigold only (accept unknown fields), or route marigold traffic to fallback binary that uses older parser compiled with permissive flag.
alice: we can hotpatch the parser config for the pool via admin API. I can roll a config change to permissive parsing for tenant marigold. That requires a config push + routing refresh. Risk: permissive parsing may accept malformed payloads but will keep customers online.
marigold-ops: prefer permissive fallback for now. Business-critical flows are blocked.
alice: preparing admin call. Command I will run:
```
POST /admin/v1/pools/ded-marigold-01/config
{
  "tenant_overrides": {"marigold": {"funcall_parser_mode": "permissive"}}
}
```
deploy-bot: Received config push request from alice. Validating... schema ok.
carla: while that's rolling, we should increase logging for these calls and create an eval to replay failed requests to see if output differs.
alice: starting rollout now — small percentage first (10%) then ramp. I’ll monitor error rate and tail latency. Rolling to 10% @ 14:07 UTC.
ben: @alice thanks. If permissive patch doesn't work we can route marigold to an older model variant in a cold pool. That requires warming but possible.
alice: 14:09 UTC — 10% rollout done. Error rate down to 9% from 15%.
marigold-ops: seeing partial recovery in customer console, a few invoices processed.
alice: ramping to 50%.
carla: I've prepared a fallback config to route all marigold toolcalls to model-v1.9 (older parser). That'd be a heavier mitigation but safer than schema changes on customer side.
alice: 14:14 UTC — 50% complete. Error rate now ~3.5%, tail latency stable. Proceeding to 100%.
ben: I'm going to take over monitoring while @alice prepares the postmortem and communicates RCA.
alice: handing off to ben for oncall — full roll completed at 14:16 UTC. Error rate back to baseline. Handing postmortem to @carla for parser fix and to @sre-rotation for followup.
ben: acked, I'll monitor for 30m and coordinate customer comms with marigold-ops.
marigold-ops: appreciate the fast response. We'll alert our SREs to stop sending meta_v2 for now; working on client deploy to revert to meta.
carla: next steps: 1) bake a permissive-parser permanent flag for dedicated pools; 2) add schema versioning and feature flag to runtime so new fields are ignored by default; 3) backport a parser tolerant patch + add unit tests; 4) add telemetry for unknown fields to avoid silent regressions.
alice: filing incident ticket and tagging components: runtime/funcall-parser, routing/pools, admin-config. I'll include the config diff and rollout timeline.
sre-rotation: noted. We'll assign follow-up owners and include marigold in the scheduled postmortem. No cross-tenant impact — classify as P2 for dedicated-customer outage.
deploy-bot: deployment record: config push alice -> ded-marigold-01 @ 2025-09-12T14:07:03Z, rollout 10/50/100% -> success.
ben: closing thread in 30m if stable. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
